逐項完成本階段動作，在結果表保留輸入、公式或狀態轉移、輸出及版本。將每個輸出對到以下判準，不能以「已做完」代替工程證據：圖上須能追蹤輸入至交付端。把工作週期及質量近似帶入低推力速度增量估算。
steps.instructionEn:
Dawn used ion propulsion to explore Vesta and Ceres, illustrating long low-thrust operation rather than brief impulses. Draw an interface map after checking the source. Mark the overlap of power availability, propulsion enable, allowed attitude and navigation estimation.
Carry out each action and retain inputs, formulas or state transitions, outputs, and revision. Map every output to the following criterion; completing an activity is not acceptance evidence: The diagram must trace the input to its recipient. Include duty cycle and a mass approximation in a low-thrust velocity-increment estimate.

steps.instruction:
速度增量偏低可能是停機、推力偏差或方向誤差；以工作計時及姿態歷史分別查核。
對照「低推力模式介面」的名義結果，分別建立物理故障與量測／紀錄偏移兩個解釋。指定一項能分辨它們的獨立觀察，再依證據選擇處置。教學任務需要 60 m/s，0.60 工作率方案不足，須重排時程或下修任務。

Against the nominal Low-thrust mode interface result, build competing physical-fault and sensing/logging-offset explanations.
